limitations: Custodian/provider assertions are not independently authenticated signatures or a complete financial audit.

Loan collateral and its custody subletters secure principal; never count both as independent backing.
Ripple Prime is account equity including open-trade equity, not off-exchange custody.
Live ownership, encumbrance, liabilities, provider balances and current reserve composition remain unverified.

backing.basis: Anchored on this analyzer's own flags: COVERAGE_WARN 1.0 (par) -> 4/5, COVERAGE_CRIT 0.98 -> 2/5, and par + COVERAGE_DRIFT_PP (2.0pp) -> 5/5. A delta-neutral synthetic targets par, not 130%, so the generic scale rates its design state 3/5 'Watch'. A WARN below par can no longer coexist with a 4/5.
backing.expires_reason: Par and two flag thresholds; none drifts.

mint_redeem.stables_delta_limit_semantics: caps only a delta FAVOURABLE to the counterparty (mint: USDe > collateral; redeem: collateral > USDe). Protocol-favourable deltas (fees) are not bounded on-chain; they are set per signed RFQ. 0 is not a zero-fee guarantee.
mint_redeem.pause_note: no pause function; the gatekeeper disables by zeroing caps
mint_redeem.assets_note: events + direct probes; USDC/USDT/DAI were constructor-added (no AssetAdded event). Assets outside the probe list may be missed.
mint_redeem.access: permissioned: orders need a whitelisted benefactor and are executed by MINTER_ROLE / REDEEMER_ROLE holders (RFQ). Not retail access.

mint_redeem.realized_spreads_basis: per executed order: collateral/USDe - 1, in bps (negative on redeem = fee)

liquidity.two_pct_depth_basis: A FLOOR, not a measurement. The deepest rung quoted ($5,000,000) still clears inside 200bps, so the crossing is somewhere above where we look. Publishing it as '2% depth' would read as a limit we found. SLIPPAGE CONVENTION: TOTAL over the fill (not marginal impact at the margin), measured against this venue's own smallest quoted rung. ⚠️ That reference EXCLUDES the smallest rung's own spread, so the figure is price impact and NOT the holder's all-in cost — which is fill_ratio (output_usd / size). Both are real and they answer different questions. The same ladder classifies differently under total vs marginal and under impact vs all-in, so both halves are stated for cross-producer comparison.

depth_50bps.basis: A FLOOR, not a measurement. The deepest rung quoted ($5,000,000) still clears inside 50bps, so the crossing is somewhere above where we look. Publishing it as '0.5% depth' would read as a limit we found. exit_mark.slippage_bps_basis: PRICE IMPACT against this venue's own smallest quoted rung, which EXCLUDES that rung's own spread — it is not the holder's all-in cost. The all-in figure is fill_ratio (output_usd / size). Impact is measured this way deliberately, so peg discount and source lag do not leak into it.

threshold_review.note: The existing total_2pct_depth fields and primary_threshold_bps remain paired at 200bps. primary_depth selects depth_50bps as the stable-valued primary on the same quotes. Equal floors do not establish an equal crossing; neither threshold changes scores.

definition.consumer_migration: Select primary_depth (alias of depth_50bps); do not combine the legacy primary_threshold_bps label with this neutral primary. BM consumer acceptance and served verification remain required.
definition.threshold_comparison: impact deterioration exceeds the positive threshold magnitude
definition.cost_boundary: Impact excludes baseline spread; all-in quoted fill ratio is separate. Average fill impact is not a derivative marginal rate, and quotes do not prove fills, gas-inclusive cost or settlement.
definition.selection: BM venue-only USDe overlay preserves this base ladder; DexTracker depth-publishing sUSDe->USDe overlay owns its own selected route.

backing.collateral_ratio_basis: Backing / supply INCLUDING the reserve fund (coverage_ratio_with_reserve_fund x 100). The conservative coverage excluding the reserve fund is in backing.secondary and sits lower; the two diverge precisely when the fund is absorbing something. ⚠️ USDe is delta-neutral, not overcollateralised: par is the design target, so the generic [130,110,100,90] rates its intended state 'Watch'. Cutoffs are anchored on this analyzer's own COVERAGE_WARN (1.0) and COVERAGE_CRIT (0.98).
backing.surplus_deficit_basis: Implied by the rated ratio: total_backing - total_backing/(collateral_ratio/100), i.e. the surplus INCLUDING the reserve fund. ⚠️ NOT total_backing - total_supply, which excludes the fund and is published as surplus_deficit_ex_reserve_fund.
